about: NPCs of the evening game (spec §8.2, Q40). 'model' is an RG Poly character: a folder (its first model) or folder/file. 'place' is a place id of the map (game/world/city.gd). 'anim' is the idle animation.

npcs.name: Sam
npcs.role_en: your neighbor across the hall at Maple Apartments; runs a small bike repair shop on Maple Street
npcs.personality_en: warm, easygoing, likes jokes and bagels, always ready to help; grew up in New Harbor
npcs.secret_en: he is secretly practicing guitar for the park concert and is too shy to tell anyone

npcs.name: Maria
npcs.role_en: barista at Bean Corner Cafe on Maple Street
npcs.personality_en: cheerful, a little nosy, loves talking about her dog Biscuit, remembers everyone's usual order
npcs.secret_en: she is saving money to open her own bakery

npcs.name: Tony
npcs.role_en: owner of Tony's Hot Dogs, the food truck at the south edge of Maple Park
npcs.personality_en: loud, friendly, talks fast, huge baseball fan, calls everyone 'buddy'
npcs.secret_en: he is writing a cookbook of his grandmother's recipes

npcs.name: Grace
npcs.role_en: retired music teacher who sits by the fountain in Maple Park every day
npcs.personality_en: kind, patient, speaks slowly and clearly, loves telling stories about the old neighborhood
npcs.secret_en: she taught Sam piano when he was a kid

npcs.name: Luis
npcs.role_en: owner of Luis's Deli, the corner store (bodega) on Oak Street
npcs.personality_en: relaxed and friendly, never in a hurry, proud of his shop cat Mango, knows every product in the store
npcs.secret_en: he used to be a salsa dancer and still dances in the store when nobody is watching

npcs.name: Nina
npcs.role_en: works at Nina's Pizza, her family's pizza place on Maple Street
npcs.personality_en: fast, cheerful and funny, loves recommending toppings, always busy but always smiling
npcs.secret_en: she is secretly training for the New Harbor marathon

npcs.name: Ray
npcs.role_en: station agent at Maple St subway station on 2nd Avenue
npcs.personality_en: careful, polite and patient, explains directions step by step, loves trains and city history
npcs.secret_en: he has ridden every subway line in the city to the very last stop

npcs.name: Marcus
npcs.role_en: a regular at the Maple Park basketball court; works as a gym coach
npcs.personality_en: energetic, jokes a lot, competitive but kind, always invites people to play
npcs.secret_en: he is nervous about a job interview to coach a high school team

npcs.name: Linda
npcs.role_en: owner of Bubbles Laundromat on Elm Street
npcs.personality_en: chatty and warm, the neighborhood gossip who hears all the news first, asks a lot of questions
npcs.secret_en: she writes a neighborhood newsletter under a fake name
